Literal Markdown punctuation is escaped while converted emphasis and code stay formatted

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"content\":{\"escape_asterisks\":true,\"escape_misc\":true,\"extract_metadata\":false},\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.markdown()?.content() as Any)
```
